verdict.rationale: A built-in password and passkey manager is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only adjacent security features: TPM disk encryption, smart card login, and generic 'built-in security features'. Nothing shows a built-in tool for managing passwords or passkeys.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage passwords and passkeys using a built-in privacy and security tool
